name: pulse-verity
description: Read crypto reference-price observations and verify signed receipts. Limited BTC, ETH and SOL samples need no API key. Catalogue rows and surrounding metadata are unsigned; coverage and account allowances vary.

PULSE_API_KEY.title: Pulse API key (optional)
PULSE_API_KEY.description: Optional. Leave blank for limited BTC, ETH and SOL samples. For broader requests, use your own developer key from https://thepulse.markets/developers?ref=mcp-npm&utm_campaign=cursor-plugin-npm#/signup (Developer plan, no charge). Access, coverage and usage allowances depend on your account and current availability.
